{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Gluten-Free|Gluten-Free]]

This '''wheat-free baking mix''' is a mixture of several other flours that, along with the addition of xanthan gum or guar gum, approximates [[Cookbook:Flour#Wheat Flour|wheat flour]].

==Ingredients==
* 2 parts (28.5%) by weight [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|white rice flour]]
* 2 parts (28.5%) by weight [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|brown rice flour]]
* 2 parts (28.5%) by weight [[Cookbook:Tapioca Starch|tapioca starch]]
* 1 part (14%) by weight [[Cookbook:Amaranth|amaranth]] flour
* 2–4% by weight [[Cookbook:Xanthan Gum|xanthan gum]] (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Combine all ingredients. Mix until very thoroughly blended.
# Use the blend as a substitute for wheat flour, using the same weight of the blend as of the wheat flour; for example, if a recipe calls for 100 g wheat flour, use 100 g of this blend.

==Notes, tips and variations==
* Cakes, cookies, and other tender baked goods will need less xanthan gum. Breads and chewier doughs will need more xanthan gum.
